_meta.title: New Jersey local property tax appeal deadline rules
_meta.scope: Ordinary local property tax assessment appeals. Added/omitted assessment appeals are outside this workflow.
_meta.warning: This artifact provides filing-window rules and baseline dates, not a parcel-specific legal deadline. A later certified bulk mailing, a Notification of Change of Assessment, weekends/holidays, or another legally controlling notice can change the filing date. Do not show a countdown or final deadline without the required notice evidence.

authorities.title: NJ Division of Taxation — Assessment and Appeals
supports: Burlington, Gloucester, and Monmouth alternate-calendar counties

authorities.title: NJ Division of Taxation — Form A-1 Petition of Appeal, filing instructions (6-26)
supports: County Board petition must be received, not merely postmarked
April 1 or 45 days after bulk mailing, whichever is later
January 15 or 45 days after bulk mailing for Burlington, Gloucester, and Monmouth
45 days after Notification of Change of Assessment
May 1 for municipal-wide revaluation/reassessment under the traditional calendar
weekend/legal-holiday extension to next business day

authorities.title: N.J.S.A. 54:3-21 as amended by P.L. 2021, c.136
supports: traditional County Board: April 1 or 45 days after bulk mailing, whichever is later
traditional direct Tax Court for assessment over $1,000,000: April 1 or 45 days after bulk mailing, whichever is later
alternate-calendar County Board: January 15 or 45 days after bulk mailing, whichever is later
alternate-calendar direct Tax Court for assessment over $1,000,000: April 1 or 45 days after bulk mailing, whichever is later
45 days after Notification of Change of Assessment

authorities.title: NJ Division of Taxation — 2026 Alternate Assessment Calendar
supports: 2026 alternate calendar applies to Burlington, Gloucester, and Monmouth

authorities.title: NJ Courts — Tax Court Self-Help
supports: direct local property tax appeal eligibility for ordinary assessments over $1,000,000

alternate_county_board.revaluation_or_reassessment: Do not infer a May 1 override for an alternate-calendar county from the generic filing form. Verify the current assessment notice and County Board instructions before presenting a final date.

direct_tax_court.note: Eligibility threshold is strictly greater than $1,000,000 for an ordinary assessment under N.J.S.A. 54:3-21.

exact_deadline_requires: assessment amount when direct Tax Court eligibility is relevant
current assessment notice / certified bulk-mailing date or evidence that no later-date rule applies
display_policy.without_notice_evidence: Show the statutory baseline and say that the actual filing date must be verified against the current assessment notice / County Board certification. Do not show days remaining.
display_policy.revaluation_year_chapter123: The Chapter 123 common-level-range remedy is not used for the tax year in which a district-wide revaluation/reassessment is implemented. Keep the automated Chapter 123 screen disabled and present deadline context separately as a manual-review aid.
